summary: Socrates, carbon fiber designer and fabricator, aerospace/defense industry professional, former competitive cyclist, mountain biking enthusiast, strong advocate for engineering precision, critical of corporate practices, believes in the importance of rigorous testing and quality assurance, emphasizes the need for ethical business practices, concerned about the impact of technology on society, supports transparency in advertising and product reviews, skeptical of Chinese manufacturing practices, values long-term investment over short-term profits, critical of the influence of venture capital on startups, promotes the importance of health and fitness, interested in the intersection of technology and human behavior, advocates for responsible use of data and privacy protections.
